description: The outcome badge a block may carry — the verdict a review left on the work, not the block's own state. A marker is always painted as an icon AND a localized word, never as a colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1). The value is nullable on AgentLaneBlock.Marker: null means "no verdict yet", which is not the same as any member of this enum, so a component renders no marker at all rather than a neutral one.

members.name: ChangesRequested
members.description: A reviewer asked for changes; the work is not done yet.

members.name: Review
members.description: The block is under review and no verdict exists yet.
